name: Grill House
title: grillhousebenidorm.com – The First and best American Themed Restaurant in Benidorm… Ice cold beers, finger licking ribs, with a private rooftop terrace for all your events!
paragraphs: Here at the Grill House Benidorm; recently renovated and designed to create four different atmospheres in one, you will find an attractive menu with something for everyone.
See your hand-cut steaks charcoal grilled in the restaurant area, eat in our bar-diner whilst watching live sports coverage, or eat outdoors on our street terrace and enjoy Spains wonderful weather.

The Grill House Benidorm caters for large and small parties including “stags and hens” and we also have a Rooftop Bar and Terrace where you can hold private parties if you want to impress your family and friends.
